description: This Dart file implements the main activity (HomeActivity) for a Flutter application. It provides a scaffold with an app bar and navigation drawer, managing different fragments/screens corresponding to various features such as Home, COVID-19 info, Payment, Rides, and more. The class manages user profile display, drawer item selection, and dynamic content rendering based on selected menu items.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main widget representing the application's home activity with navigation drawer and app bar, handling user profile info and fragment switching.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class managing drawer selection state, user info, and rendering different fragments based on user interaction.

classes.name: _DrawerItem
classes.description: Model class representing each drawer menu item with icon and label.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeActivity.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes user display name and email from passed parameters or stored preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Scaffold widget with AppBar, Drawer, and dynamic body content.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Constructs the navigation drawer including profile header and menu items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment widget based on the selected drawer item.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a drawer item, updating the selected index and closing the drawer.
